title: martius-lab/lodos
abstract: # Lodos Lodos is a *research codebase* for running massively parallelized simulations of rigid-body dynamics with contact. It is particularly optimized for achieving high-throughput in scenes involving collisions between large numbers of detailed meshes. The framework builds upon two of our previous works: * `papers/lodos_v1.pdf`: The first version of the framework, under review. The current codebase incorporates significant extensions beyond this initial version, as described in `papers/lodos_v2.pdf`. These developments will eventually find their way into a follow-up publication. * `papers/contact_tutorial.pdf`: *(Coming soon)* A tutorial on discrete time-stepping methods for simulating cone-complementarity-based contact dynamics. It concludes by proposing a general proximal minimization blueprint, and this codebase essentially constitutes a concrete implementation. From an implementation perspective, Lodos is built entirely using [NVIDIA Warp](https://nvidia.github.io/warp/). Its architecture builds upon a core subset of the [MJWarp](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_warp) codebase, particularly its constraint model and its excellent GPU implementation of a nonsmooth Newton solver with exact line-search. ## How to Get Started? * Read through `papers/lodos_v1.pdf` and `papers/lodos_v2.pdf` to understand the context around Lodos and its contributions. * *(Once the paper is released to public)* Read through `papers/contact_tutorial.pdf` (coming soon) to understand the theory behind Lodos. * Read `viewer/README.md` to run interactive simulations of an existing catalogue of scenes. * Read `bench/README.md` to reproduce the benchmark comparing Lodos to [MJWarp](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_warp) and [Kamino](https://disneyresearch.github.io/kamino-site/). * Run the examples in `notebooks/` to familiarize yourself with the API. * Read `tools/performance_tuning/README.md` to understand how to tune Lodos simulations to maximize throughput. * Read `tool
abstract_zh: Lodos 是一个用于运行大规模并行刚体接触动力学仿真的研究代码库，特别针对涉及大量精细网格碰撞场景的高吞吐量进行了优化。该框架基于我们之前的两项工作：`papers/lodos_v1.pdf`（框架第一版，正在审稿中）和 `papers/contact_tutorial.pdf`（即将发布，关于基于锥互补的接触动力学离散时间步进方法教程，最终提出通用的近端最小化蓝图，本代码库是其具体实现）。当前代码库包含了超出初始版本的重要扩展，详见 `papers/lodos_v2.pdf`，这些进展将最终形成后续发表。从实现角度看，Lodos 完全使用 NVIDIA Warp 构建，其架构基于 MJWarp 代码库的核心子集，特别是其约束模型和优秀的非光滑牛顿求解器 GPU 实现（带精确线搜索）。
tldr_zh: Lodos 是基于 NVIDIA Warp 的高吞吐刚体接触仿真代码库。
cover_zh: 刚体碰撞仿真还能这么玩？Lodos 让吞吐量直接拉满
